_comment: Guided demo investigations (challenge: 'a couple of demonstration examples the user could watch'). Run scripts/build_demos.py once with credentials to cache their REAL data; afterwards they are served instantly from the cache.

demos.title: Is Chennai getting warmer?
demos.story: Start simple: air temperature at one point, 1981-2024. Watch how removing the seasonal cycle reveals the trend, and how the tests agree.

demos.title: Is monsoon rainfall in Tamil Nadu changing?
demos.story: Rainfall is noisy. Even if a trend exists, it may not be significant yet. The detectability horizon tells you how many more years you would need.

demos.title: Farmland greening in Punjab (MODIS NDVI)
demos.story: Satellite vegetation index over intensively irrigated farmland. Look for trend breaks and test robustness with the trend triangle.

demos.title: Same monsoon, opposite trends?
demos.story: Compare rainfall trends in two regions with a multiple-testing correction, the challenge's 'one way here, the opposite way there' case.
